scoring: Full continuous native-rate trials; movement and valid reference; initial32samples excluded; equal-trial mean RMSE for full orientation/inclination/heading. No reference labels initialize inference.
selection: No test-driven model, precision, hyperparameter or architecture selection
raw_data_policy: Model, integer format, evaluator recipe and build frozen before download; pinned raw SHA recorded before parsing
physical_scope: Four separate RESET plus1000continuoussteps; compare96states/4raw/sequence/CRC/status/cycles. Held-out full-trial accuracy uses the verified CPU integer reference; entire heldout is not replayed overUSB.
test_precision_policy: Report measured change and clipping/zero counts; do not retune on test outcomes
